name: Greater Boston
summary: Boston and the connected inner-ring cities and towns between Route 2, Route 16, and the harbor.

name: Burlington & Route 128
summary: Burlington and nearby Route 128 and I-93 communities with direct connections across the northern suburbs.

name: Greater Lowell & Nashoba
summary: The Lowell area and Nashoba Valley communities linked by Routes 2, 3, and I-495.

name: Merrimack Valley
summary: Lower Merrimack Valley cities and towns extending from the I-93 corridor to the New Hampshire line and coast.

name: North Shore
summary: The coastal and inland North Shore from Saugus and Lynn through Cape Ann and the Ipswich corridor.

name: Route 2 & MetroWest
summary: Route 2 and MetroWest communities west and southwest of Burlington, connected through I-95 and I-495.

name: South of Boston & Route 128
summary: Communities south of Boston and along the southern Route 128 arc, including established coastal edge markets.
